info.name: Instagram Social Media Automation API Engine
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the AI-Powered Instagram Social Media Automation System (Phases 1-12).
Covers Captions, Hashtags, Content Ideas, AI Comparison, Brand Voice Refinement, Quality Evaluation, Vision AI, History & Usage, Instagram Graph API Publishing, and Automated Scheduling.

Evaluates content across 6 pillars: natural language, originality, brand voice, grammar, hook strength, CTA quality.
